name: letak-worker-coopjednota
description: Detects new leaflets across COOP Jednota Slovensko's three store banners (Tempo, Supermarket, Potraviny) and returns their metadata + URLs (no downloads).
author: sim0n92

execute.description: Fetch coop.sk's three banner leaflet listing pages, parse leaflets, and return the ones not present in knownLeaflets.

outputPath.description: Absolute path where the result JSON document must be written.

knownLeaflets.description: Leaflet keys already known to the caller, each formatted as 'type|from|to|id'. NOTE: unlike other chains' 3-part 'type|from|to' key, coopjednota uses a 4-part key because its federated regional co-ops can publish multiple distinct leaflets under the same banner and date range at once - the 'id' disambiguates them.

types.description: Case-insensitive banner filter: 'Tempo', 'Supermarket', 'CoopPotraviny'. Empty means all three.

pageUrls.description: Override map of banner name -> listing page URL (e.g. {"Tempo": "https://coop.sk/sk/pdfflip/1"}). Merged over the three production defaults (Tempo, Supermarket, CoopPotraviny), so a partial override only replaces the given banner(s); unknown keys add extra banners.

id.description: Stable internal record id (from the PDF path, e.g. 'flip_1343' -> '1343'). Part of the novelty key alongside type+from+to (coopjednota-specific 4-part key, unlike the 3-part type|from|to key used by other chains) - required to tell apart regional-co-op variants that share the same type and date range.

terminate.description: Stop an in-progress fetch/parse and exit cleanly.
